note: The documented meaning of each PF_* index of the WDK 7.1 winnt.h (MSDN IsProcessorFeaturePresent, Windows 7). Values are NOT here: gen_x86sys.py computes each from Wine 9.0's own code (wineboot.c ProcessorFeatures, system.c get_cpuinfo) over the CPUID record of the declared CPU (precedence level 2: the documentation defines the meaning, not how Windows computes it). Meaning text is given only where the MSDN text is known; the rest is named by the WDK constant only.
meaning_source: MSDN, IsProcessorFeaturePresent function (Windows 7 / Windows Server 2008 R2 documentation)

meanings.0: On a Pentium, a floating-point precision error can occur in rare circumstances
meanings.1: Floating-point operations are emulated using a software emulator
meanings.2: The atomic compare and exchange operation (cmpxchg8b) is available
meanings.3: The MMX instruction set is available
meanings.6: The SSE instruction set is available
meanings.10: The SSE2 instruction set is available
meanings.13: The SSE3 instruction set is available
meanings.14: The atomic compare and exchange 128-bit operation (cmpxchg16b) is available
meanings.17: The processor implements the XSAVE and XRSTOR instructions

others.source: MSDN IsProcessorFeaturePresent, return value: zero when the feature is not supported; the WDK 7.1 winnt.h defines indices 0..17 only. Wine 9.0 also sets higher indices of newer Windows (e.g. PF_FASTFAIL_AVAILABLE, Windows 8+), which contradicts the declared build 7601 (precedence 1: documentation).
